cards.en: What is the biggest lie you told to skip a family event, and did anyone ever find out?
cards.hi: Kisi family function se bachne ke liye aapne sabse bada jhooth kya bola? Kya kisi ko kabhi pata chala?

cards.en: What is the most obvious hint you gave a crush that they completely missed?
cards.hi: Aapne apne crush ko sabse obvious hint kya diya, jo unhone bilkul miss kar diya?

cards.en: Describe your most awkward date or first meeting with someone, without saying their name.
cards.hi: Apni sabse awkward date ya kisi ke saath pehli mulaqat ke baare mein bataiye, bina naam liye.

cards.en: What rumour about yourself would you secretly love people to believe?
cards.hi: Apne baare mein kaunsa rumour aapko secretly pasand aayega, agar log use sach maan lein?

cards.en: What is the most awkward question a relative has asked you at a family gathering?
cards.hi: Kisi family function mein kisi rishtedaar ne aapse sabse awkward sawaal kya poocha hai?

cards.en: What is the worst thing you have accidentally said out loud in front of a teacher, boss, or someone's parent?
cards.hi: Teacher, boss ya kisi ke parents ke saamne galti se aapke munh se sabse awkward kya nikal gaya?

cards.en: What is the most money you have wasted on something you used only once?
cards.hi: Aisi kaunsi cheez par aapne sabse zyada paise waste kiye jo sirf ek baar use hui?

cards.en: What did you do at a wedding or party that people still remind you about?
cards.hi: Kisi shaadi ya party mein aapne aisa kya kiya tha jo log aaj tak yaad dilate hain?

cards.en: What is one thing you did that your family still believes was someone else's fault?
cards.hi: Aapki kaunsi galti ka blame aaj bhi aapki family kisi aur par daalti hai?

cards.en: What is the strangest place you have met someone you later had a crush on?
cards.hi: Sabse ajeeb jagah kaunsi hai jahan kisi se mulaqat hui aur baad mein aapko unpar crush ho gaya?

cards.en: What is the worst gift you have ever given someone you were dating, and how did they react?
cards.hi: Kisi ko date karte waqt aapne unhe ab tak ka sabse bekaar gift kya diya hai, aur unka reaction kya tha?
cards.edited: near-duplicate of a Friends never-have-I-ever (typed then deleted a message)

cards.en: Which app would embarrass you most if everyone saw how many hours you spend on it?
cards.hi: Kis app par bitaye ghante sab dekh lein to aapko sabse zyada sharam aayegi?

cards.en: What small habit made you suddenly lose interest in someone you liked?
cards.hi: Kisi ki kaunsi chhoti si aadat ki wajah se aapka interest achanak khatam ho gaya?

cards.en: Have you ever had feelings for a friend's crush or ex? Without naming anyone, how did you handle it?
cards.hi: Kya aapko kabhi kisi dost ke crush ya ex ke liye feelings hui hain? Bina naam liye bataiye, kaise handle kiya?

cards.en: What is a promise you made at a party that you never kept?
cards.hi: Party mein kiya kaunsa promise aapne kabhi poora nahi kiya?

cards.en: What skill have you lied about having, and did anyone ever ask you to prove it?
cards.hi: Aapne kaunsi skill ke baare mein jhooth bola hai? Kya kisi ne kabhi prove karne ko kaha?

cards.en: What is the most childish revenge you have ever taken on a sibling, friend, or roommate?
cards.hi: Bhai-behen, dost ya roommate se aapne sabse bachkana badla kya liya hai?

cards.en: What did you loudly judge someone for doing, and then later do yourself?
cards.hi: Aapne kis baat par kisi ko zor-zor se judge kiya, aur baad mein khud wahi kar diya?

cards.en: What is something you thought was cool at 13 that now embarrasses you?
cards.hi: 13 saal ki umar mein aapko kya cool lagta tha jis par ab sharam aati hai?

cards.en: When did you last secretly check an ex or old crush's profile online, and what were you looking for?
cards.hi: Aapne aakhri baar chupke se kisi ex ya purane crush ki profile kab dekhi, aur aapko wahan kya dhoondhna tha?

cards.en: Who in this room would you trust with your unlocked phone for one hour, and why them?
cards.hi: Is room mein kis par itna bharosa hai ki ek ghante ke liye apna unlocked phone de dein? Aur kyun?

cards.en: When did you take a simple game far too seriously, and what happened?
cards.hi: Kab aapne ek simple game ko zaroorat se zyada seriously le liya, aur phir kya hua?

cards.en: What is the silliest thing you have ever argued about with a partner or best friend?
cards.hi: Partner ya best friend se aapki sabse bekaar baat par kya behes hui hai?

cards.en: If you could erase one memory about you from everyone in this room, which would it be?
cards.hi: Agar is room mein sabke dimaag se aapki ek yaad mita sakein, to woh kaunsi hogi?

cards.en: What is the weirdest thing you have done when you thought no one was watching, and someone was?
cards.hi: Aapne sabse ajeeb kya kiya jab laga koi nahi dekh raha, par koi dekh raha tha?

cards.en: Type 'I am' on your phone, then tap the middle suggestion ten times. Read it aloud; skip any word you want.
cards.hi: Phone par 'I am' type kariye, phir beech wala suggestion das baar tap kariye. Zor se padhiye; jo word nahi padhna, use skip kar dijiye.
cards.edited: player control: may skip any suggested word; added missing props/remote-ok tags

cards.en: Find the last emoji-only message you sent and perform it as a poem, turning each emoji into one line.
cards.hi: Aapka bheja aakhri sirf-emoji wala message dhoondhiye aur use poem ki tarah sunaiye, har emoji ki ek line.

cards.en: Let the group pick one of your phone's default wallpapers for you; keep it until the game ends.
cards.hi: Group ko apne phone ke default wallpapers mein se ek chunne dijiye; game khatam hone tak wahi lagaye rakhiye.

cards.en: Play 15 seconds of the last song you listened to on your phone while everyone dances along.
cards.hi: Phone par aakhri suna hua gaana 15 second chalaiye, aur sab saath mein dance karein.

cards.en: Give an emotional 20-second award speech thanking the bottle for choosing you, holding a cup or phone as your trophy.
cards.hi: Cup ya phone ko trophy bana kar 20 second ki emotional award speech dijiye, aur bottle ko aapko chunne ke liye thank you boliye.

cards.en: Say a famous film dialogue like the actor who said it; the group guesses the film.
cards.hi: Koi famous film dialogue usi actor ke style mein boliye; group film ka naam guess karega.

cards.en: You have 30 seconds to make anyone laugh without touching them, while everyone else tries not to smile.
cards.hi: Aapke paas 30 second hain kisi ko bhi bina chhuye hansane ke liye, aur baaki sab smile rokne ki koshish karein.

cards.en: Give a serious 45-second breaking news report about the most boring thing you did today.
cards.hi: Aaj aapne jo sabse boring kaam kiya, us par 45 second ki serious breaking news report dijiye.

cards.en: For 20 seconds, act like you are trying hard to stay awake in a very boring class.
cards.hi: 20 second tak aise act kariye jaise ek bahut boring class mein jaagte rehne ki poori koshish chal rahi ho.

cards.en: Choose a player and describe everything they do for 20 seconds, like an excited sports commentator.
cards.hi: Ek player chuniye aur 20 second tak unki har harkat ko excited sports commentator ki tarah describe kariye.

cards.en: Walk around the room for one minute; whenever anyone claps, freeze like a funny statue until the next clap.
cards.hi: Ek minute tak room mein ghoomiye; jab bhi koi taali bajaye, agli taali tak funny statue ban jaiye.

cards.en: Let the group give you a villain name, then introduce yourself in your best movie-villain voice.
cards.hi: Group ko aapka villain naam rakhne dijiye, phir apni best villain wali awaaz mein apna intro dijiye.

cards.en: In 30 seconds, convince the group that Monday is the best day of the week.
cards.hi: 30 second mein group ko convince kariye ki Monday hafte ka sabse best din hai.

cards.en: Walk across the room in slow motion like a movie hero leaving an explosion, while everyone makes loud boom sounds.
cards.hi: Blast se nikalte film hero ki tarah slow motion mein room paar kariye, aur sab zor se boom ki awaaz nikaalein.

cards.en: Explain how to make instant noodles, step by step, in the voice of a very tired robot.
cards.hi: Ek bahut thake hue robot ki awaaz mein step by step samjhaiye ki instant noodles kaise banate hain.

cards.en: Laugh as loudly as you can for 15 seconds; everyone else must join in until time is up.
cards.hi: 15 second tak jitna zor se ho sake hansiye; time khatam hone tak baaki sabko bhi saath hansna hai.

cards.en: Have a 30-second argument with yourself about cats versus dogs, switching sides after every sentence.
cards.hi: Billi vs kutta par khud se 30 second behes kariye, aur har sentence ke baad side badaliye.

cards.en: Dance for 20 seconds without moving your feet while the group hums any song they choose.
cards.hi: Pair hilaaye bina 20 second dance kariye, jabki group apni pasand ka koi bhi gaana gungunaaye.

cards.en: Let the group pick an animal and ask you one job interview question; answer it as that animal.
cards.hi: Group ek janwar chunega aur aapse ek job interview sawaal poochega; us janwar ban kar jawab dijiye.

cards.en: Describe your perfect weekend for 30 seconds without saying the word 'I'. Everyone shouts 'Caught!' whenever you say it.
cards.hi: 30 second tak apna perfect weekend describe kariye, bina 'main' ya 'I' bole. Jab bhi bolein, sab 'Caught!' chillayenge.

cards.en: Make up a four-line rap about the player on your right, and keep every line kind.
cards.hi: Apne right wale player par chaar line ka rap banaiye, aur har line pyaari honi chahiye.

cards.en: Say the alphabet backwards, from Z to A, in under 30 seconds.
cards.hi: 30 second se kam mein ABCD ulta boliye, Z se A tak.

cards.en: Act out your whole morning routine in just 10 seconds, with no words, while the group guesses each step.
cards.hi: Sirf 10 second mein bina bole apna poora morning routine act kariye, aur group har step guess karega.

cards.en: Introduce each player like a palace guard announcing royal guests, giving each one a grand title.
cards.hi: Shahi mehal ke guard ki tarah har player ko shaan se announce kariye, aur har ek ko grand title dijiye.

cards.en: Pretend you are a famous chef presenting an imaginary dish made from three foods the group names.
cards.hi: Ek famous chef ban kar ek imaginary dish present kariye, jo group ki batayi teen cheezon se bani ho.

cards.en: Would you rather your friends read your old school diary, or your family hear every voice note you sent this year?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: dost aapki purani school diary padhein, ya family is saal ke aapke saare voice notes sune?

cards.en: Would you rather go on a date planned by your family, or one planned by everyone in this room?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: family ki plan ki hui date, ya is room mein sabki plan ki hui date?

cards.en: Would you rather see your ex at every party for a year, or have your ex become your new boss?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: saal bhar har party mein ex dikhe, ya ex aapka naya boss ban jaaye?

cards.en: Would you rather answer every question honestly for a whole day, or accept every dare for a whole day?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: poore din har sawaal ka sach jawab dena, ya poore din har dare accept karna?

cards.en: Would you rather sing every sentence for the rest of this party, or speak only in whispers?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: baaki party mein har sentence gaa kar bolna, ya sirf phusphusa kar baat karna?

cards.en: Would you rather go viral for a cooking disaster, or for tripping on stage while collecting an award?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: cooking disaster ke liye viral hona, ya award lete waqt stage par phisalne ke liye?

cards.en: Would you rather give a wedding speech with no preparation, or dance alone for a full song at a wedding?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: bina tayyari ke shaadi mein speech dena, ya shaadi mein poora gaana akele naachna?

cards.en: Would you rather get free food for life at one restaurant, or free travel for one year?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: ek restaurant mein zindagi bhar free khana, ya ek saal free travel?

cards.en: Never have I ever pretended my phone battery died to avoid replying to someone.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi reply se bachne ke liye phone ki battery khatam hone ka bahana nahi banaya.

cards.en: Never have I ever rehearsed a conversation with a crush in front of a mirror.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi mirror ke saamne crush se baat karne ki practice nahi ki.

cards.en: Never have I ever gone on a date mainly for the free food.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi sirf free khane ke liye date ko haan nahi kaha.

cards.en: Never have I ever taken more than 20 photos just to get one good selfie.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi ek achhi selfie ke liye 20 se zyada photos nahi li.

cards.en: Never have I ever chosen my outfit for a party just to impress one person.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi sirf ek insaan ko impress karne ke liye party ka outfit nahi chuna.

cards.en: Never have I ever practised my autograph for when I become famous.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi famous hone ke din ke liye apne autograph ki practice nahi ki.

cards.en: Never have I ever secretly read someone's messages over their shoulder.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi ke kandhe ke peeche se chupke se unke messages nahi padhe.

cards.en: Never have I ever attended a wedding where I did not know the couple at all.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi aisi shaadi attend nahi ki jahan couple se meri koi jaan-pehchaan hi nahi thi.

cards.en: Who is most likely to fall in love on a trip and never come back?
cards.hi: Kiske trip par pyaar mein pad kar wahin reh jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to become best friends with the DJ by the end of the night?
cards.hi: Kiske raat khatam hote-hote DJ ka best friend ban jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to turn a two-line birthday wish into a twenty-minute speech?
cards.hi: Kiske do line ki birthday wish ko bees minute ki speech bana dene ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to stay good friends with all their exes?
cards.hi: Kiske apne saare exes ke saath achhi dosti nibhaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to leave a party without saying goodbye to anyone?
cards.hi: Kiske bina kisi ko bye bole party se nikal jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to plan a surprise party and accidentally tell the person about it?
cards.hi: Kiske surprise party plan karke galti se usi insaan ko bata dene ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to bargain the price down in any shop or market?
cards.hi: Kiske kisi bhi dukaan ya market mein mol-bhaav karke daam kam karwa lene ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to escape trouble by telling a story so wild that everyone believes it?
cards.hi: Kiske aisi wild kahani suna kar musibat se bach nikalne ke chances sabse zyada hain jis par sab yakeen kar lein?

cards.en: What is the most creative excuse you have used to leave a party or hangout early?
cards.hi: Party ya hangout se jaldi nikalne ke liye aapne sabse creative bahana kya banaya hai?

cards.en: Have you ever been friend-zoned? What was the exact moment you realised it?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi kisi ne aapko friend-zone kiya hai? Kis moment par aapko samajh aaya?

cards.en: If you had to write a five-word dating app bio for yourself, what would it say?
cards.hi: Agar apni dating app bio sirf paanch words mein likhni pade, to woh kya hogi?

cards.en: What is the most boring first message you have ever sent or received on a chat or dating app?
cards.hi: Chat ya dating app par aapne sabse boring pehla message kaunsa bheja ya receive kiya hai?

cards.en: What is one thing from an old crush or old relationship that you have still kept?
cards.hi: Kisi purane crush ya relationship ki kaunsi cheez aapne aaj bhi sambhaal kar rakhi hai?

cards.en: If your exes or old friends wrote an online review of you, how many stars would you get, and why?
cards.hi: Agar aapke exes ya purane dost aapka online review likhein, to kitne star milenge aur kyun?

cards.en: What is the most awkward place you have bumped into an ex or old crush?
cards.hi: Kisi ex ya purane crush se achanak sabse awkward jagah par mulaqat kahan hui hai?

cards.en: Which forward from a family WhatsApp group have you believed, even for a minute?
cards.hi: Family WhatsApp group ka kaunsa forward aapne ek minute ke liye hi sahi, sach maan liya tha?

cards.en: Has anyone ever dragged you onto the dance floor at a sangeet or party? How did it go?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi kisi ne aapko sangeet ya party mein zabardasti dance floor par kheecha hai? Phir kya hua?

cards.en: What is the most creative way you have sneaked snacks into a class, cinema or office meeting?
cards.hi: Class, cinema ya office meeting mein snacks chupa kar le jaane ka aapka sabse creative tareeka kya raha hai?

cards.en: Without saying who it is, what is the funniest name you have saved someone as in your phone?
cards.hi: Bina bataye ki kaun hai, aapne phone mein kisi ka sabse funny naam kya save kiya hai?

cards.en: How many unread messages do you have right now? Guess who here has the most.
cards.hi: Abhi aapke phone mein kitne unread messages hain? Guess kariye yahan sabse zyada kiske honge.

cards.en: What is the most embarrassing caption or status you ever posted that you hope nobody remembers?
cards.hi: Aapne sabse embarrassing caption ya status kaunsa post kiya tha, jo kaash ab kisi ko yaad na ho?

cards.en: What is one dating red flag that you secretly have yourself?
cards.hi: Aisa kaunsa dating red flag hai jo secretly khud aap mein bhi hai?

cards.en: Who here would you call to rescue you from a bad date, and what excuse would they use?
cards.hi: Bekaar date se bachne ke liye yahan kisko call karna pasand hoga, aur unka bahana kya hoga?

cards.en: What outfit from your past do you hope has no photos left anywhere?
cards.hi: Purana kaunsa outfit hai jiski kaash ab kahin koi photo na bachi ho?

cards.en: What is the worst song choice you have ever made at karaoke or antakshari?
cards.hi: Karaoke ya antakshari mein aapne ab tak sabse bekaar gaana kaunsa chuna hai?

cards.en: Which Bollywood or movie dialogue do you use in real life far too often?
cards.hi: Kaunsa Bollywood ya film dialogue real life mein aapke munh se kuch zyada hi nikalta hai?

cards.en: Have you ever skipped something important to watch a cricket match or a big game? What was it?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi cricket match ya koi bada game dekhne ke liye koi zaroori kaam chhoda hai? Kya tha woh?

cards.en: What topic can keep you talking for hours over chai, even when everyone else is bored?
cards.hi: Kaunsa topic chhidte hi chai par aapki baatein ghanton chalti hain, chahe baaki sab bore ho jaayein?

cards.en: Have you ever gone on a date with someone you met on an app? What surprised you most?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi app par mile kisi insaan ke saath aapki date hui hai? Sabse bada surprise kya tha?

cards.en: Have you ever told your family you were at a friend's place when you were somewhere else? Where were you?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi family se kaha 'main dost ke ghar hoon', jabki asli location kuch aur thi? Woh kahan thi?

cards.en: What is the most embarrassing thing your phone has autocorrected in a message you sent?
cards.hi: Aapke bheje message mein autocorrect ne sabse embarrassing gadbad kya ki hai?

cards.en: What is the longest you have spent getting ready for a party, and was it worth it?
cards.hi: Kisi party ke liye ready hone mein aapne sabse zyada kitna time lagaya hai, aur kya woh worth it tha?

cards.en: What is the worst love or dating advice you have ever given a friend?
cards.hi: Aapne kisi dost ko ab tak ki sabse bekaar love ya dating advice kya di hai?

cards.en: Have you ever ghosted someone, or been ghosted? Which one felt worse?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi kisi ko ghost kiya hai, ya kisi ne aapko? Dono mein se zyada bura kya laga?

cards.en: What is the silliest reason you have ever muted or unfollowed someone online?
cards.hi: Aapne kabhi kisi ko online mute ya unfollow kiya hai? Sabse bachkani wajah kya thi?

cards.en: Have you ever left a group chat dramatically? Did you sneak back in later?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi drama karke koi group chat chhoda hai? Baad mein chupke se wapas join kiya?

cards.en: What is the longest you have kept a friend's secret? Tell us how long, not the secret.
cards.hi: Kisi dost ka secret aapne sabse lamba kitne time tak chhupaya hai? Sirf time bataiye, secret nahi.

cards.en: What is the longest you have stayed on a phone call with someone you liked?
cards.hi: Kisi pasand ke insaan ke saath aapki sabse lambi phone call kitni der chali hai?

cards.en: What is the worst date idea you have ever heard of or actually tried?
cards.hi: Aapne ab tak sabse bekaar date idea kaunsa suna hai, ya sach mein try kiya hai?

cards.en: What is one thing you would never do on a first date, no matter what?
cards.hi: Pehli date par aisi kaunsi cheez hai jo kisi bhi haal mein aapse nahi hogi?

cards.en: Have you ever liked someone only from their messages, before really meeting them? What happened?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi sirf kisi ke messages se hi aapka dil unpar aa gaya, milne se pehle? Phir kya hua?

cards.en: What is the wildest trip you have taken with friends, and what went wrong first?
cards.hi: Doston ke saath aapki sabse wild trip kaunsi rahi hai, aur sabse pehle kya gadbad hui?

cards.en: What is the funniest thing that has happened to you during a festival like Diwali, Holi, Eid or Christmas?
cards.hi: Diwali, Holi, Eid ya Christmas jaise kisi tyohaar par aapke saath sabse funny kya hua hai?

cards.en: Which song do you always ask for at parties, even when everyone is tired of it?
cards.hi: Kaunsa gaana har party mein aapki request par zaroor bajta hai, chahe sab usse thak chuke hon?

cards.en: Have you ever been the third wheel? What was the most awkward moment?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi aapko third wheel banna pada hai? Sabse awkward moment kya tha?

cards.en: What is the shortest crush or relationship you have ever had, and why did it end so fast?
cards.hi: Aapka sabse chhota crush ya relationship kitne din chala, aur itni jaldi khatam kyun ho gaya?

cards.en: Have you ever said 'I love you' too early? What happened next?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi 'I love you' bahut jaldi bol diya hai? Uske baad kya hua?

cards.en: What is the biggest fight you have had over a TV remote, Wi-Fi password or phone charger?
cards.hi: TV remote, Wi-Fi password ya phone charger ko lekar aapki sabse badi ladaai kaunsi hui hai?

cards.en: What fake name or fake story have you ever given to a stranger, and why?
cards.hi: Kisi anjaan ko aapne kabhi fake naam ya fake kahani batayi hai? Kya aur kyun?

cards.en: Have you ever planned a 'random' run-in with someone you liked? Did they suspect anything?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi kisi pasand ke insaan se 'achanak' milne ka poora plan banaya hai? Kya unhe kuch shak hua?
cards.edited: repeated another Party truth (what you did at a wedding or party)

cards.en: Have you ever pretended not to see someone you knew in public? Why did you avoid them?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi bahar kisi jaan-pehchaan ke insaan ko dekh kar bhi andekha kiya hai? Kyun?

cards.en: With your eyes closed, type 'This party is amazing' on your phone, then show everyone what you typed.
cards.hi: Aankhein band karke phone par 'This party is amazing' type kariye, phir sabko dikhaiye kya type hua.

cards.en: Name the last app you downloaded, or any app you like, and give it a dramatic 20-second movie trailer.
cards.hi: Aakhri download kiya app ya koi bhi app chuniye, aur uska 20 second ka dramatic movie trailer boliye.

cards.en: Read out the strangest alarm or reminder name on your phone, then explain why you made it.
cards.hi: Apne phone ka sabse ajeeb alarm ya reminder naam padh kar sunaiye, phir bataiye woh kyun banaya tha.

cards.en: Start your phone's stopwatch and try to stop it at exactly 5 seconds without looking. You get three tries.
cards.hi: Phone ki stopwatch start kariye aur bina dekhe theek 5 second par rokne ki koshish kariye. Teen chances milenge.

cards.en: Invent a chant for this party and get everyone to shout it three times, louder each time.
cards.hi: Is party ke liye ek naara banaiye aur sabse teen baar bulwaiye, har baar pehle se zyada zor se.

cards.en: Start counting around the circle. Players clap instead of saying any number that has a 7. Keep going until someone slips.
cards.hi: Circle mein ginti shuru kariye. Jis number mein 7 ho, uski jagah taali bajani hai. Koi galti kare tab tak chalte rahiye.

cards.en: Start a round of antakshari: sing one line, and the next player sings a song starting with its last letter.
cards.hi: Antakshari ka ek round shuru kariye: ek line gaaiye, aur agle player ko aakhri akshar se naya gaana gaana hai.

cards.en: Be the party DJ: beatbox any beat for 20 seconds while everyone dances to it.
cards.hi: Party ke DJ baniye: 20 second tak munh se koi beat bajaiye aur sab uspar dance karein.

cards.en: Give a 30-second wedding speech for two objects in this room getting married, like a proud relative.
cards.hi: Is room ki do cheezon ki shaadi ho rahi hai: ek proud rishtedaar ki tarah 30 second ki speech dijiye.

cards.en: Do a famous dance step from a Bollywood or any film song; the group has 20 seconds to guess the song.
cards.hi: Kisi Bollywood ya film gaane ka famous dance step kariye; group ke paas gaana guess karne ke liye 20 second hain.

cards.en: Be a cricket umpire: give each player a dramatic 'six' or 'four' signal for their party energy, and say why.
cards.hi: Cricket umpire baniye: har player ki party energy ke liye dramatic 'six' ya 'four' ka signal dijiye, aur wajah bataiye.

cards.en: Whisper a silly sentence to the next player and pass it around the room. The last player says it aloud.
cards.hi: Agle player ke kaan mein ek funny sentence phusphusaiye aur poore room mein aage badhwaiye. Aakhri player use zor se bole.

cards.en: Each player describes an imaginary dating profile in one line; you react loudly with 'Match!' or 'No match!'
cards.hi: Har player ek line mein koi imaginary dating profile bataye; aap zor se 'Match!' ya 'No match!' boliye.

cards.en: Break up with a slipper or shoe in a dramatic 30-second speech, then change your mind and make up.
cards.hi: Ek chappal ya joote se 30 second ki dramatic speech mein breakup kariye, phir mann badal kar patch-up kar lijiye.

cards.en: Be an over-dramatic fortune teller and predict one funny, kind thing about each player's love life.
cards.hi: Over-dramatic fortune teller ban kar har player ki love life ke baare mein ek funny, pyaari prediction kariye.

cards.en: Play a nosy relative at a wedding and ask each player one funny, nosy question. They answer in one line.
cards.hi: Shaadi mein nosy rishtedaar ka role kariye: har player se ek funny, taang adaane wala sawaal poochiye. Jawab ek line mein.

cards.en: Do 30 seconds of loud stand-up comedy about dating apps, using a spoon or pen as your microphone.
cards.hi: Chammach ya pen ko mic bana kar dating apps par 30 second ki zor-daar stand-up comedy kariye.

cards.en: Hold a 30-second press conference as a superstar announcing a shock retirement; the group fires questions at you.
cards.hi: Ek superstar ban kar 30 second ki press conference kariye aur achanak retirement announce kariye; group ek ke baad ek sawaal poochega.
cards.edited: near-duplicate of a Kids dare (paper ball throw)

cards.en: Be a phone voice assistant: each player asks you one question, and you give a confident but totally wrong answer.
cards.hi: Phone ka voice assistant baniye: har player ek sawaal pooche, aur aap poore confidence se bilkul galat jawab dijiye.

cards.en: React to shocking news like a TV serial star: turn your head dramatically three times while everyone makes drum sounds.
cards.hi: TV serial star ki tarah kisi shocking news par react kariye: teen baar dramatic style mein sar ghumaiye, sab 'dhum-dhum' bolein.

cards.en: A willing player acts out any movie scene with no sound. For 30 seconds, you dub every voice and sound effect.
cards.hi: Ek willing player bina awaaz koi movie scene act kare. 30 second tak aap har dialogue aur sound effect dub kariye.

cards.en: Tell two true facts and one lie about your crushes or dating life; the group guesses the lie.
cards.hi: Apne crushes ya dating life ke baare mein do sach aur ek jhooth bataiye; group jhooth pakdega.

cards.en: Act out getting off a very crowded train or metro at your stop, saying 'excuse me' in five different ways.
cards.hi: Bheed bhari train ya metro se apne stop par utarne ka act kariye, 'excuse me' paanch alag tarikon se bolte hue.

cards.en: A willing player acts as a shopkeeper. You have 30 seconds to bargain the price of an imaginary item down.
cards.hi: Ek willing player dukaandaar bane. Aapke paas 30 second hain, kisi imaginary cheez ka daam mol-bhaav karke kam karwaiye.

cards.en: Lead a pretend wedding baraat around the room, playing an imaginary trumpet while everyone dances behind you.
cards.hi: Room mein ek nakli baraat nikaaliye: aage-aage imaginary trumpet bajaiye, aur sab naachte hue aapke peeche chalein.
cards.edited: same joke as another Party dare (break up with a slipper)

cards.en: Choose a player to be your biggest fan for 20 seconds; they cheer loudly at every boring thing you do.
cards.hi: Ek player ko 20 second ke liye apna sabse bada fan chuniye; aapke har boring kaam par woh zor se cheer karein.

cards.en: Pretend an ex just walked into this party. Act out your reaction twice: as a movie hero, then as a villain.
cards.hi: Maan lijiye abhi party mein kisi ex ki entry hui hai. Do baar react kariye: pehle film hero ki tarah, phir villain ki tarah.

cards.en: Would you rather have every dating app match be someone you already know, or only match with people far away?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: dating app ka har match koi jaan-pehchaan wala ho, ya har match bahut door rehne wala?

cards.en: Would you rather have autocorrect change every 'ok' into 'I love you', or every 'haha' into 'Who are you?'
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: autocorrect har 'ok' ko 'I love you' bana de, ya har 'haha' ko 'Who are you?'

cards.en: Never have I ever pretended to know the words at a sangeet or party and just mumbled loudly.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi sangeet ya party mein lyrics pata na hone par bhi zor-zor se ulta-seedha nahi gaaya.

cards.en: Never have I ever joined a dating app just to see who from my college or office was on it.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi sirf ye dekhne ke liye dating app join nahi kiya ki college ya office se kaun-kaun wahan hai.

cards.en: Who is most likely to start a huge debate in the family WhatsApp group by accident?
cards.hi: Kiske galti se family WhatsApp group mein badi behes shuru kar dene ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to reply to an ex's story, then say their thumb slipped?
cards.hi: Kiske ex ki story par reply karke phir 'ungli phisal gayi' bolne ke chances sabse zyada hain?
